name: William Lilly
description: The most famous English astrologer of the 17th century, author of Christian Astrology.
note: Date adjusted to Gregorian (May 11, 1602) from Julian (April 30, 1602).

name: Marsilio Ficino
description: Renaissance philosopher and priest who pioneered the use of archetypal medical astrology.

name: Isaac Newton
description: Polymath who studied the 'pristine knowledge' of the ancients, including alchemy and astrology.
note: Date adjusted to Gregorian (January 4, 1643) from Julian (December 25, 1642).

name: Napoleon Bonaparte
description: French military leader and emperor who conquered much of Europe.

name: Elizabeth I
description: Queen of England and Ireland (1558-1603), the last monarch of the House of Tudor.

name: Queen Victoria
description: Queen of the United Kingdom and Ireland, and Empress of India.

name: Abraham Lincoln
description: 16th President of the United States, led the nation through the American Civil War.
